name: LXRXXL ZYNTH
author: L'Cronx
summary: An experimental 8-track synth with 19 voices on unconventional maths (Lorenz chaos, Hilbert frequency shifter, Euclidean rhythms) and voices coded after the DX7, CZ, Minimoog, Hammond, NES chips, Braids and Plaits. LXR-02 style sequencer with random functions, tape/digital delay, mixer and presets.
